environment: Chromium 141 headless (SwiftShader), Linux container, local game server behind a stall/cut relay

detail.msg: Could not reach the game server.

stall: "Reconnecting…" shows when the network drops
stall: the browser's "online" signal retries at once instead of waiting out a hung attempt

network never returns: the "connection lost" screen with a way home, within the grace period
network never returns: "Main menu" works
engine download fails: says it did not load and offers Reload (not "no 3D graphics")

frames keep failing: the failing work is halted (no endless error loop behind the screen)
